title.zh: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二
title.raw: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二 Volume 2 Annals 2: Taizu 2

sentences.zh: 洪武元年春正月乙亥，祀天地於南郊，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, on the day yihai in the first month of spring, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb and assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the inaugural year of Hongwu, on the yihai day of the first spring month, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar and took the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 定有天下之號曰明，建元洪武。

translations.literal: He fixed the name of possession of All-under-Heaven as Ming and established the reign era Hongwu.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed the name of the realm as Ming and adopted Hongwu as the reign title.

sentences.zh: 追尊高祖考曰玄皇帝，廟號德祖，曾祖考曰恆皇帝，廟號懿祖；

translations.literal: He posthumously honored his great-grandfather as Emperor Xuan, with temple name Dezu, and his great-great-grandfather as Emperor Heng, with temple name Yizu;
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously honored his great-grandfather as Emperor Xuan, temple name Dezu, and his great-great-grandfather as Emperor Heng, temple name Yizu;

sentences.zh: 祖考曰裕皇帝，廟號熙祖，皇考曰淳皇帝，廟號仁祖，妣皆皇后。

translations.literal: his grandfather as Emperor Yu, temple name Xizu, his father as Emperor Chun, temple name Renzu; all their consorts were made empresses.
translations.idiomatic: his grandfather as Emperor Yu, temple name Xizu, and his father as Emperor Chun, temple name Renzu; each of their wives was posthumously titled empress.

sentences.zh: 立妃馬氏為皇后，世子標為皇太子。

translations.literal: He installed his consort, Lady Ma, as empress and his heir Biao as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: He installed Consort Ma as empress and his heir apparent Biao as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 以李善長、徐達為左、右丞相，諸功臣進爵有差。

translations.literal: He appointed Li Shanchang and Xu Da as left and right grand councilors; meritorious ministers were advanced in rank according to their merits.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanchang and Xu Da were appointed left and right grand councilors, and the founding ministers were ennobled in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙子，頒即位詔於天下。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, he promulgated the accession edict throughout All-under-Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the accession edict was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 追封皇伯考以下皆為王。

translations.literal: He posthumously enfeoffed his imperial uncles and those below them all as kings.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously enfeoffed his imperial uncles and their descendants as kings.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李善長、徐達等兼東宮官。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Li Shanchang, Xu Da, and others also held Eastern Palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Li Shanchang, Xu Da, and others were also appointed to offices in the crown prince's household.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣使覈浙西田賦。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, he dispatched envoys to verify land-tax registers in western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, envoys were sent to audit the land-tax registers of western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，胡廷瑞克建寧。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Hu Tingrui captured Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Hu Tingrui captured Jianning.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈為征戍將軍，略南陽以北州郡。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Deng Yu was made expedition garrison general and pacified the prefectures north of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Deng Yu was appointed expedition garrison general and subdued the prefectures north of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 湯和克延平，執元平章陳友定，福建平。

translations.literal: Tang He captured Yanping, seized the Yuan Pingzhang Chen Youding, and Fujian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Tang He captured Yanping, took the Yuan Pingzhang Chen Youding prisoner, and Fujian was brought under control.

sentences.zh: 是月，天下府州縣官來朝。

translations.literal: That month, officials from all prefectures, districts, and counties came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month, magistrates and prefectural officials from across the realm came to present themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「天下始定，民財力俱困，要在休養安息，惟廉者能約己而利人，勉之。

translations.literal: He instructed them, saying: "All-under-Heaven has just been settled; the people's wealth and strength are both exhausted. What matters is to rest and recuperate. Only the incorruptible can restrain themselves and benefit others—strive toward this."
translations.idiomatic: He admonished them: "The realm has only just been pacified, and the people's resources are utterly depleted. What matters now is recovery and repose. Only officials who are honest can restrain themselves and truly serve the people—take this to heart."

sentences.zh: 」二月壬寅，定郊社宗廟禮，歲必親祀，以為常。

translations.literal: " In the second month, on the day renyin, he fixed the rites for the suburban altars, the altar of soil and grain, and the ancestral temple; each year he would personally sacrifice, taking this as the constant practice.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second month, on the renyin day, he established the rites for the suburban sacrifices, the altar of soil and grain, and the ancestral temple, decreeing that he would perform them in person every year as a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，湯和提督海運。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Tang He was put in overall charge of sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Tang He was placed in overall charge of maritime transport.

sentences.zh: 廖永忠為征南將軍，硃亮祖副之，由海道取廣東。

translations.literal: Liao Yongzhong was made southern expedition general, with Zhu Liangzu as his deputy; by the sea route they were to take Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Yongzhong was appointed southern expedition general with Zhu Liangzu as his deputy, and they advanced on Guangdong by sea.

sentences.zh: 丁未，乙太牢祀先師孔子於國學。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he offered the great tai-lao sacrifice to the late Master Confucius at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, he offered the great tai-lao sacrifice to Confucius at the National University.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀社稷。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, he sacrificed to the altar of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, he sacrificed at the altar of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔衣冠如唐制。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict ordered dress and caps to follow the Tang system.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, an edict decreed that official dress and caps should follow Tang dynasty regulations.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，常遇春克東昌，山東平。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Chang Yuchun captured Dongchang, and Shandong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Chang Yuchun captured Dongchang, and Shandong was brought under control.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，楊璟克寶慶。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Yang Jing captured Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Yang Jing captured Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，詔儒臣修女誡，戒後妃毋預政。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinwei, an edict ordered Confucian ministers to compile Admonitions for Women and warned empresses and consorts not to participate in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinwei day, an edict directed Confucian scholars to compile the Admonitions for Women and warned that empresses and consorts must not meddle in affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 壬申，周德興克全州。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Zhou Dexing captured Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Zhou Dexing captured Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，鄧愈克南陽。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Deng Yu captured Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Deng Yu captured Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，徐達徇汴梁，左君弼降。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Xu Da subdued Bianliang, and Zuo Junbi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Xu Da advanced on Bianliang, and Zuo Junbi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，蘄州進竹簟，卻之，命四方毋妄獻。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day xinchou, Qizhou presented bamboo mats; he declined them and ordered the four quarters not rashly to present gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day, Qizhou presented bamboo sleeping mats; he refused them and ordered the provinces not to send unsolicited tribute.

sentences.zh: 廖永忠師至廣州，元守臣何真降，廣東平。

translations.literal: Liao Yongzhong's army reached Guangzhou; the Yuan defending minister He Zhen surrendered, and Guangdong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Yongzhong's army reached Guangzhou; the Yuan defender He Zhen surrendered, and Guangdong was pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祫享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he performed the joint-spirit-tablet sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, he performed the joint-spirit sacrifice at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐達、常遇春大破元兵於洛水北，遂圍河南。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun inflicted a great defeat on Yuan forces north of the Luo River, then besieged Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun routed the Yuan army north of the Luo River and then laid siege to Henan.

sentences.zh: 梁王阿魯溫降，河南平。

translations.literal: Prince of Liang Aruwen surrendered, and Henan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Liang, Aruwen, surrendered, and Henan was brought under control.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，楊璟克永州。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Yang Jing captured Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Yang Jing captured Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸汴梁。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, he visited Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the emperor visited Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，馮勝克潼關，李思齊、張思道遁。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Feng Sheng captured Tong Pass; Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Feng Sheng captured Tong Pass, while Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao fled.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，廖永忠下梧州，潯、貴、容、郁林諸州皆降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jimao, Liao Yongzhong took Wuzhou; the prefectures of Xun, Gui, Rong, and Yulin all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jimao day, Liao Yongzhong captured Wuzhou, and the prefectures of Xun, Gui, Rong, and Yulin all submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改汴梁路為開封府。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, he changed the Bianliang circuit to Kaifeng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the Bianliang circuit was redesignated as Kaifeng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，徐達朝行在。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengzi, Xu Da attended audience at the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengzi day, Xu Da presented himself at the mobile imperial court.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，海南、海北諸道降。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the circuits of Hainan and Haibei surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the circuits of Hainan and Haibei submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，楊璟、硃亮祖克靖江。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Yang Jing and Zhu Liangzu captured Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Yang Jing and Zhu Liangzu captured Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，廖永忠下象州，廣西平。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day wuzi, Liao Yongzhong took Xiangzhou, and Guangxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuzi day, Liao Yongzhong captured Xiangzhou, and Guangxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，振恤中原貧民。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, he provided relief and succor to the poor of the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, relief was extended to the impoverished people of the Central Plains.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，將還應天，諭達等曰：「中原之民，久為群雄所苦，流離相望，故命將北征，拯民水火。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, about to return to Yingtian, he instructed Xu Da and the others, saying: "The people of the Central Plains have long been afflicted by rival warlords, displaced and gazing at one another in despair; therefore I ordered generals on a northern expedition to rescue the people from fire and flood."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, as he was about to return to Yingtian, he instructed Xu Da and the others: "The people of the Central Plains have long suffered under rival warlords, displaced and staring at one another in despair. That is why I ordered a northern expedition—to lift the people out of fire and flood."

sentences.zh: 元祖宗功德在人，其子孫罔恤民隱，天厭棄之。

translations.literal: The Yuan ancestors' merit and virtue were among the people, yet their descendants were heedless of the people's hidden sufferings; Heaven grew weary and abandoned them.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan founders' merit still lived among the people, yet their descendants ignored the people's plight, and Heaven turned against them.

sentences.zh: 君則有罪，民復何辜。

translations.literal: The ruler had guilt—what crime had the people committed?
translations.idiomatic: The ruler was guilty—what fault lay with the common people?

sentences.zh: 前代革命之際，肆行屠戮，違天虐民，朕實不忍。

translations.literal: At the time of revolution in previous ages, they wantonly carried out slaughter, opposed Heaven and abused the people—I truly cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: In past dynastic upheavals, conquerors slaughtered without restraint, defying Heaven and brutalizing the people—I cannot bring myself to do the same.

sentences.zh: 諸將克城，毋肆焚掠妄殺人，元之宗戚，咸俾保全。

translations.literal: When generals capture cities, they must not wantonly burn, plunder, or kill people; all Yuan imperial kin are to be enabled to be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: When you capture a city, do not burn, plunder, or kill indiscriminately. All members of the Yuan imperial clan are to be protected.

sentences.zh: 庶幾上答天心，下慰人望，以副朕伐罪安民之意。

translations.literal: Thus perhaps we may answer Heaven's heart above and comfort the people's hopes below, in accord with my purpose of punishing guilt and pacifying the people.
translations.idiomatic: In this way we may answer Heaven's will and satisfy the people's hopes, fulfilling my purpose of punishing the guilty while bringing peace to the people.

sentences.zh: 不恭命者，罰無赦。

translations.literal: Those not respectful of orders—punishment without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who disobeys these orders will be punished without mercy."

sentences.zh: 」丙申，命馮勝留守開封。

translations.literal: " On the day bingchen, he ordered Feng Sheng to remain and garrison Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: " On the bingchen day, he ordered Feng Sheng to remain behind and garrison Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，至自開封。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day dingwei, he arrived from Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the dingwei day, he returned from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 己酉，徐達會諸將兵於臨清。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Xu Da assembled the generals' troops at Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Xu Da assembled the army of generals at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，常遇春克德州。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Chang Yuchun captured Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Chang Yuchun captured Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，克通州，元帝趨上都。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, they captured Tongzhou; the Yuan emperor hastened to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Tongzhou was captured, and the Yuan emperor fled toward Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 是月，征天下賢才為守令。

translations.literal: That month, worthy talent from throughout All-under-Heaven was summoned to serve as prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: That month, talented men from across the realm were summoned to serve as prefects and county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 免吳江、慶德、太平、甯國、滁、和被災田租。

translations.literal: Land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Wu, Qingde, Taiping, Ningguo, Chu, and He was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax was remitted on fields stricken by disaster in Wu, Qingde, Taiping, Ningguo, Chu, and He.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，以應天為南京，開封為北京。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jisi, Yingtian was made Southern Capital and Kaifeng Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jisi day, Yingtian was designated the Southern Capital and Kaifeng the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，徐達入元都，封府庫圖籍，守宮門，禁士卒侵暴，遣將巡古北口諸隘。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Xu Da entered the Yuan capital, sealed the storehouses and archives, guarded the palace gates, forbade soldiers from violation and violence, and dispatched generals to patrol the passes at Gubeikou and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Xu Da entered the Yuan capital, sealed the treasuries and archives, posted guards at the palace gates, forbade soldiers from looting or harming civilians, and sent generals to patrol the passes at Gubeikou and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以京師火，四方水旱，詔中書省集議便民事。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, because the capital had suffered fire and the four quarters flood and drought, an edict ordered the Secretariat to assemble and discuss measures convenient for the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, because fire had struck the capital and floods and drought afflicted the provinces, an edict directed the Secretariat to convene and discuss measures to relieve the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定六部官制。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the official system of the Six Ministries was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the official structure of the Six Ministries was established.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞劉基致仕。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Liu Ji retired from office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，赦殊死以下。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he granted amnesty below capital punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, he granted amnesty for all crimes below capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 將士從征者恤其家，逋逃許自首。

translations.literal: Soldiers and officers on campaign were to have their families succored; fugitives were permitted to surrender themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Families of soldiers on campaign were to receive support, and fugitives were permitted to turn themselves in.

sentences.zh: 新克州郡毋妄殺。

translations.literal: In newly captured prefectures and districts, no rash killing.
translations.idiomatic: In newly captured prefectures and districts, indiscriminate killing was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 輸賦道遠者，官為轉運，災荒以實聞。

translations.literal: Those paying taxes along distant routes—the government would transport for them; disasters and famine were to be reported in truth.
translations.idiomatic: Where tax transport routes were long, the government would convey goods on the people's behalf, and officials were to report disasters and famine truthfully.

sentences.zh: 免鎮江租稅。

translations.literal: Rent and tax in Zhenjiang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Rent and tax in Zhenjiang were remitted.

sentences.zh: 避亂民復業者，聽墾荒地，復三年。

translations.literal: People who had fled turmoil and returned to their occupations were permitted to reclaim wasteland, with exemption for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees returning to their occupations were permitted to reclaim wasteland, with a three-year tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 衍聖公襲封及授曲阜知縣，並如前代制。

translations.literal: The Duke Continuing the Sage's succession enfeoffment and appointment as magistrate of Qufu were all as under the previous dynasty's system.
translations.idiomatic: The succession of the Duke Continuing the Sage and the appointment of the magistrate of Qufu were carried out according to the precedents of earlier dynasties.

sentences.zh: 有司以禮聘致賢士，學校毋事虛文。

translations.literal: Officials were to invite and bring worthy gentlemen according to ritual; schools were not to engage in empty formalities.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were to invite worthy scholars according to proper ritual, and schools were not to indulge in empty formalities.

sentences.zh: 平刑，毋非時決囚。

translations.literal: Punishments were to be evened; prisoners were not to be executed at improper times.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments were to be applied fairly, and prisoners were not to be executed at improper seasons.

sentences.zh: 除書籍田器稅，民間逋負免征。

translations.literal: Tax on books and farm implements was abolished; common people's arrears were exempt from levy.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on books and farm implements were abolished, and private tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 蒙古、色目人有才能者，許擢用。

translations.literal: Mongols and Semu people with ability were permitted to be promoted and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Talented Mongols and Central Asians were permitted to be promoted and employed in office.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨廢疾者，存恤之。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, and the disabled were to be stored up and succored.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, the childless elderly, and the disabled were to be cared for.

sentences.zh: 民年七十以上，一子復。

translations.literal: People seventy years of age and above—one son was exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: For households with a member aged seventy or above, one son was exempted from corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 他利害當興革不在詔內者，有司具以聞。

translations.literal: Other benefits and harms to be instituted or abolished not within the edict—officials were to report in full.
translations.idiomatic: Any other reforms or abolitions not covered in this edict were to be reported in full by the responsible officials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸北京。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he visited the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the emperor visited the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 改大都路曰北平府。

translations.literal: The Dadu circuit was changed to Beiping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadu circuit was redesignated Beiping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 征元故臣。

translations.literal: Former Yuan ministers were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Former Yuan officials were summoned to serve.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔徐達、常遇春取山西。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, an edict ordered Xu Da and Chang Yuchun to take Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, an edict ordered Xu Da and Chang Yuchun to conquer Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，放元宮人。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Yuan palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the women of the Yuan palace were released.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，詔曰：「天下之治，天下之賢共理之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guihai, an edict said: "The governance of All-under-Heaven—All-under-Heaven's worthies jointly govern it."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guihai day, an edict proclaimed: "To govern the realm requires the worthy men of the realm to govern it together."

sentences.zh: 今賢士多隱岩穴，豈有司失於敦勸歟，朝廷疏於禮待歟，抑朕寡昧不足致賢，將在位者壅蔽使不上達歟？

translations.literal: Now many worthy gentlemen hide in caves and cliffs—is it that officials failed in earnest encouragement, that the court was remiss in courteous treatment, or that I am dull and insufficient to obtain worthies, or that those in office obstruct so none reach the upper levels?
translations.idiomatic: Yet many worthy men now hide in seclusion. Is it that local officials have failed to encourage them earnestly? That the court has been remiss in honoring them? That I am too dull to attract talent? Or that those in office have blocked their path to the throne?

sentences.zh: 不然，賢士大夫，幼學壯行，豈甘沒世而已哉。

translations.literal: If not so, worthy scholar-officials, studying in youth and bold in action in their prime—how could they be willing to die obscurely and that be all?
translations.idiomatic: Surely not—for worthy scholar-officials who studied in youth and aspired to serve in their prime, how could they be content to die in obscurity?

sentences.zh: 天下甫定，朕願與諸儒講明治道。

translations.literal: All-under-Heaven has just been settled; I wish with the various Confucians to discuss clarifying the Way of governance.
translations.idiomatic: The realm has only just been pacified, and I wish to discuss the principles of good government with the scholars.

sentences.zh: 有能輔朕濟民者，有司禮遣。

translations.literal: Those able to assist me and benefit the people—officials are respectfully to dispatch them.
translations.idiomatic: Those who can assist me in bringing relief to the people are to be escorted to court with all due ceremony."

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，常遇春下保定，遂下真定。

translations.literal: " On the day yichou, Chang Yuchun took Baoding, then took Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: " On the yichou day, Chang Yuchun captured Baoding and then Zhending.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，馮勝、湯和下懷慶，澤、潞相繼下。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day gengwu, Feng Sheng and Tang He took Huaiqing; Ze and Lu fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengwu day, Feng Sheng and Tang He captured Huaiqing, and Ze and Lu submitted in turn.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，至自北京。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, he arrived from the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, he returned from the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以元都平，詔天下。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, because the Yuan capital had been pacified, an edict was issued to All-under-Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, because the Yuan capital had been pacified, an edict was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，遣使分行天下，訪求賢才。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jihai, envoys were dispatched in separate routes throughout All-under-Heaven to seek worthy talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jihai day, envoys were sent throughout the realm in separate circuits to seek out worthy talent.

sentences.zh: 庚子，始祀上帝於圜丘。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, he first sacrificed to the Supreme Lord at the Circular Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, he performed the inaugural sacrifice to the Supreme Lord at the Circular Altar.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔劉基還。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, an edict ordered Liu Ji to return.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, an edict summoned Liu Ji back to office.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，徐達克太原，擴廓帖木兒走甘肅，山西平。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingmao, Xu Da captured Taiyuan; Köke Temür fled to Gansu, and Shanxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao day, Xu Da captured Taiyuan; Köke Temür fled to Gansu, and Shanxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置登聞鼓。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Petition-to-Heaven drum was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the Petition-to-Heaven drum was installed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以書諭明昇。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, by letter he instructed Ming Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, he sent a letter instructing Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙巳，立功臣廟於雞籠山。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the day yisi, the Meritorious Ministers Temple was established on Jilong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the yisi day of the first spring month, a temple to the meritorious ministers was established on Jilong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he offered at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, he offered sacrifice at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔曰：「朕淮右布衣，因天下亂，率眾渡江，保民圖治，今十有五年。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, an edict said: "I, a cloth-clad man of Huai's right, because All-under-Heaven was in turmoil, led the masses across the Yangzi to protect the people and seek order—now fifteen years."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, an edict proclaimed: "I was but a commoner of the Huai region. When the realm fell into chaos, I led my followers across the Yangzi to protect the people and seek good government. That was fifteen years ago."

sentences.zh: 荷天眷祐，悉皆戡定。

translations.literal: Receiving Heaven's gracious protection, all were quelled.
translations.idiomatic: By Heaven's gracious favor, all has been brought to order.

sentences.zh: 用是命將北征，齊魯之民饋糧給軍，不憚千里。

translations.literal: Therefore I ordered generals on a northern expedition; the people of Qi and Lu presented grain to supply the army, not fearing a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I ordered a northern expedition, and the people of Qi and Lu supplied the army with grain, traveling a thousand li without complaint."

sentences.zh: 朕軫厥勞，已免元年田租。

translations.literal: I grieved their labor and have already remitted the first year's land tax.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of their toil, I have already remitted the first year's land tax.

sentences.zh: 遭旱民未蘇，其更賜一年。

translations.literal: The people had not yet recovered from drought; they were granted another year.
translations.idiomatic: Because drought had left the people unrecovered, they were granted another year's exemption.

sentences.zh: 頃者大軍平燕都，下晉、冀，民被兵燹，困征斂，北平、燕南、河東、山西今年田租亦與蠲免。

translations.literal: Recently the great army pacified the Yan capital and took Jin and Ji; the people suffered from the flames of war and the hardships of levies. Land tax this year in Beiping, south of Yan, Hedong, and Shanxi is likewise remitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the great army pacified the Yan capital and subdued Jin and Ji, the people suffered war and crushing levies. This year's land tax in Beiping, southern Yan, Hedong, and Shanxi is likewise remitted.

sentences.zh: 河南諸郡歸附，久欲惠之，西北未平，師過其地，是以未遑。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Henan submitted long ago, and I have long wished to show them favor; the northwest was not yet pacified, and when the army passed through their territory I had no leisure.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures of Henan submitted long ago, and I have long wished to show them favor, but the northwest was not yet pacified and the army's passage left me no leisure to do so.

sentences.zh: 今晉、冀平矣，西抵潼關，北界大河，南至唐、鄧、光、息，今年稅糧悉除之。

translations.literal: Now Jin and Ji are pacified, west to Tong Pass, north to the Great River, south to Tang, Deng, Guang, and Xi—this year's tax grain is entirely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Jin and Ji are pacified—from Tong Pass in the west to the Great River in the north and Tang, Deng, Guang, and Xi in the south—this year's tax grain is entirely abolished."

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「應天、太平、鎮江、宣城、廣德供億浩穰。

translations.literal: " Another edict said: "Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Xuancheng, and Guangde supply the court's needs in great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: " Another edict said: "Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Xuancheng, and Guangde bear the heaviest burden of supplying the court."

sentences.zh: 去歲蠲租，遇旱惠不及下。

translations.literal: Last year rent was remitted, but drought struck and the benefit did not reach the lowest levels.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's rent remission was followed by drought, and the benefit did not reach the common people.

sentences.zh: 其再免諸郡及無為州今年租稅。

translations.literal: Those prefectures and Wuzhou are again exempted from this year's rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: Those prefectures and Wuzhou are again exempted from this year's rent and tax."

sentences.zh: 」庚申，常遇春取大同。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Chang Yuchun took Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Chang Yuchun captured Datong.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇山東濱海郡縣。

translations.literal: That month, Japanese pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Japanese pirates raided the coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅朔，詔修元史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day bingyin, the first of the month, an edict ordered the compilation of the History of Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, the bingyin day, an edict ordered the compilation of the History of Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，徐達至奉元，張思道遁。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengzi, Xu Da reached Fengyuan; Zhang Sidao fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengzi day, Xu Da reached Fengyuan and Zhang Sidao fled.

sentences.zh: 振陝西饑，戶米三石。

translations.literal: Relief was extended for famine in Shaanxi—three piculs of grain per household.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was extended in Shaanxi at three piculs of grain per household.

sentences.zh: 丙午，常遇春至鳳翔，李思齊奔臨洮。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Chang Yuchun reached Fengxiang; Li Siqi fled to Lintao.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Chang Yuchun reached Fengxiang and Li Siqi fled to Lintao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，遇春還師北平。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day bingyin, Chang Yuchun returned his army to Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingyin day, Chang Yuchun returned his army to Beiping.

sentences.zh: 己巳，諸王子受經於博士孔克仁。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the imperial princes received the classics from Erudite Kong Keren.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the imperial princes began studying the classics under Erudite Kong Keren.

sentences.zh: 令功臣子弟入學。

translations.literal: The sons of meritorious ministers were ordered to enter the schools.
translations.idiomatic: The sons of meritorious ministers were ordered to enter the schools.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，編《祖訓錄》，定封建諸王之制。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Ancestral Instructions Record was compiled and the system of enfeoffing feudal princes was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Ancestral Instructions Record was compiled and the system of enfeoffing imperial princes was established.

sentences.zh: 徐達下鞏昌。

translations.literal: Xu Da took Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da captured Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜秦、隴新附州縣稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, tax grain was granted to newly submitted prefectures and counties of Qin and Long.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, tax grain was granted to the newly submitted prefectures and counties of Qin and Long.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，馮勝至臨洮，李思齊降。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Feng Sheng reached Lintao and Li Siqi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Feng Sheng reached Lintao and Li Siqi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，徐達襲破元豫王於西寧。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Xu Da made a surprise attack and defeated the Yuan Prince of Yu at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Xu Da routed the Yuan Prince of Yu at Xining in a surprise attack.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiawu, the first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, the jiawu day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，徐達下平涼、延安。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Xu Da took Pingliang and Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Xu Da captured Pingliang and Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 張良臣以慶陽降，尋叛。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangchen surrendered with Qingyang, but soon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangchen surrendered with Qingyang but soon rebelled.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，始祀地於方丘。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, he first sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, he performed the inaugural sacrifice to Earth at the Square Mound.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，常遇春克開平，元帝北走。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jimao, Chang Yuchun captured Kaiping and the Yuan emperor fled north.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jimao day, Chang Yuchun captured Kaiping and the Yuan emperor fled north.

sentences.zh: 壬午，封陳日煃為安南國王。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Chen Rijiong was enfeoffed as king of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Chen Rijiong was enfeoffed as king of Annan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，鄂國公常遇春卒於軍，詔李文忠領其眾。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day jihai, Duke of E Chang Yuchun died in the army; an edict ordered Li Wenzhong to take command of his forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jihai day, Duke of E Chang Yuchun died on campaign; an edict ordered Li Wenzhong to take command of his army.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，擴廓帖木兒遣將破原州、涇州。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Köke Temür dispatched generals who broke Yuanzhou and Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Köke Temür sent generals who recaptured Yuanzhou and Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，馮勝擊走之。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Feng Sheng attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Feng Sheng attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，明昇遣使來。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Ming Sheng dispatched envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Ming Sheng dispatched envoys.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，元兵攻大同，李文忠擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingyin, Yuan forces attacked Datong; Li Wenzhong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingyin day, Yuan forces attacked Datong and Li Wenzhong defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，定內侍官制。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the eunuch official system was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the eunuch official system was established.

sentences.zh: 諭吏部曰：「內臣但備使令，毋多人，古來若輩擅權，可為鑒戒。

translations.literal: He instructed the Ministry of Personnel: "Eunuchs are only to serve as messengers—do not employ many. Throughout history when such men seized power it served as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: He instructed the Ministry of Personnel: "Eunuchs are only to carry out orders—employ few of them. Throughout history, when such men seized power, the lesson was plain."

sentences.zh: 馭之之道，當使之畏法，勿令有功，有功則驕恣矣。

translations.literal: The way to control them is to make them fear the law; do not let them achieve merit, for with merit they grow arrogant and unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: The way to control them is to make them fear the law; do not let them win merit, for merit makes them arrogant and unrestrained."

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，《元史》成。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the History of Yuan was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the History of Yuan was completed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，封王顓為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Wang Zhuan was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Wang Zhuan was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，徐達克慶陽，斬張良臣，陝西平。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Xu Da captured Qingyang, executed Zhang Liangchen, and Shaanxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Xu Da captured Qingyang, executed Zhang Liangchen, and Shaanxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 是月，命儒臣纂禮書。

translations.literal: That month, Confucian ministers were ordered to compile ritual books.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Confucian ministers were ordered to compile books of ritual.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，召徐達、湯和還，馮勝留總軍事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinchou, Xu Da and Tang He were recalled; Feng Sheng remained to command the army overall.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinchou day, Xu Da and Tang He were recalled, while Feng Sheng remained in overall command of the army.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以臨濠為中都。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Linhuang was made Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Linhuang was designated Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，征南師還。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the southern expedition army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the southern expedition army returned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，遣楊璟諭明昇。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day renxu, Yang Jing was dispatched to instruct Ming Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renxu day, Yang Jing was dispatched to instruct Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，甘露降於鐘山，群臣請告廟，不許。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, sweet dew fell on Zhong Mountain; the ministers requested to report it at the temple, but he did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, sweet dew fell on Zhong Mountain; the ministers asked to report it at the ancestral temple, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔天下郡縣立學。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, an edict ordered schools established in all prefectures and counties under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, an edict ordered schools established in every prefecture and county in the realm.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣使貽元帝書。

translations.literal: That month, envoys were dispatched bearing a letter to the Yuan emperor.
translations.idiomatic: That month, envoys were sent bearing a letter to the Yuan emperor.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，祀上帝於圜丘，以仁祖配。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yisi, he sacrificed to the Supreme Lord at the Circular Altar, with Renzu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yisi day, he sacrificed to the Supreme Lord at the Circular Altar, with Renzu as associate.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，封阿答阿者為占城國王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, Adada was enfeoffed as king of Champa.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiaxu day, Adada was enfeoffed as king of Champa.

sentences.zh: 甲申，振西安諸府饑，戶米二石。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, famine in the prefectures of Xi'an was relieved at two piculs of grain per household.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, famine in the Xi'an prefectures was relieved at two piculs of grain per household.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大賚平定中原及征南將士。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, great rewards were bestowed on those who pacified the Central Plains and the southern expedition generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, lavish rewards were bestowed on those who had pacified the Central Plains and on the generals and soldiers of the southern expedition.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，擴廓帖木兒攻蘭州，指揮於光死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Köke Temür attacked Lanzhou; Commander Yu Guang died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Köke Temür attacked Lanzhou and Commander Yu Guang died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、安南、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Annan, and Goryeo presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Annan, and Goryeo presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸巳，徐達為征虜大將軍，李文忠、馮勝、鄧愈、湯和副之，分道北征。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the day guisi, Xu Da was made great general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as deputies; they marched north by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the guisi day of the first spring month, Xu Da was appointed great general for the northern campaign, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as deputies, advancing north by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，追封郭子興滁陽王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guiwei, Guo Zixing was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chuyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guiwei day, Guo Zixing was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chuyang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔求賢才可任六部者。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, an edict sought worthy talent capable of serving in the Six Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, an edict sought worthy talent capable of serving in the Six Ministries.

sentences.zh: 是月，李文忠下興和，進兵察罕腦兒，執元平章竹貞。

translations.literal: That month, Li Wenzhong took Xinghe and advanced to Chaghanur, seizing the Yuan Pingzhang Zhuzhen.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Li Wenzhong captured Xinghe, advanced to Chaghanur, and seized the Yuan Pingzhang Zhuzhen.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，免南畿、河南、山東、北平、浙東、江西廣信、饒州今年田租。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengyin, this year's land tax was remitted in the southern capital region, Henan, Shandong, Beiping, eastern Zhe, Jiangxi, Guangxin, and Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengyin day, this year's land tax was remitted in the southern capital region, Henan, Shandong, Beiping, eastern Zhe, Jiangxi, Guangxin, and Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，封皇子樉為秦王，棡晉王，棣燕王，橚吳王，楨楚王，榑齊王，梓潭王，杞趙王，檀魯王，從孫守謙靖江王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yichou, the imperial sons were enfeoffed: Shu as Prince of Qin, Gang as Prince of Jin, Di as Prince of Yan, Su as Prince of Wu, Zhen as Prince of Chu, Fu as Prince of Qi, Zi as Prince of Tan, Qi as Prince of Zhao, Tan as Prince of Lu, and the emperor's nephew Shouqian as Prince of Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yichou day, the princes were enfeoffed: Shu as Prince of Qin, Gang as Prince of Jin, Di as Prince of Yan, Su as Prince of Wu, Zhen as Prince of Chu, Fu as Prince of Qi, Zi as Prince of Tan, Qi as Prince of Zhao, Tan as Prince of Lu, and the emperor's nephew Shouqian as Prince of Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 徐達大破擴廓帖木兒於沈兒峪，盡降其眾，擴廓走和林。

translations.literal: Xu Da inflicted a great defeat on Köke Temür at Shen'er Valley; all his forces surrendered, and Köke fled to Khara Khoto.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da routed Köke Temür at Shen'er Valley; his entire force surrendered and Köke fled to Khara Khoto.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，元帝崩於應昌，子愛猷識理達臘嗣。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Yuan emperor died at Yingchang; his son Ayushiridara succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the Yuan emperor died at Yingchang and his son Ayushiridara succeeded.

sentences.zh: 是月，慈利土官覃垕作亂。

translations.literal: That month, the Tujia native official Tan Hu of Cili rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Tujia native official Tan Hu of Cili rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，徐達取興元。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, Xu Da took Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jichou day, Xu Da captured Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 分遣鄧愈招諭吐蕃。

translations.literal: Deng Yu was separately dispatched to summon and instruct the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu was separately dispatched to summon and instruct the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔守令舉學識篤行之士。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered prefects and magistrates to recommend scholars of solid learning and upright conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, an edict ordered prefects and magistrates to recommend scholars of solid learning and upright conduct.

sentences.zh: 己亥，設科取士。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the civil service examination was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the civil service examination was established.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李文忠克應昌。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Li Wenzhong captured Yingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Li Wenzhong captured Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 元嗣君北走，獲其子買的裏八剌，降五萬餘人，窮追至北慶州，不及而還。

translations.literal: The Yuan successor fled north; his son Maidilibali was captured and more than fifty thousand surrendered; pursuit was pressed to North Qingzhou but they returned without overtaking him.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan successor fled north; his son Maidilibali was captured and more than fifty thousand men surrendered; the pursuers pressed on to North Qingzhou but returned without overtaking him.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔行大射禮。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, an edict ordered the great archery rite to be performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, an edict ordered the great archery rite to be performed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀地於方丘，以仁祖配。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, he sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound, with Renzu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, he sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound, with Renzu as associate.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，徐達下興元。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Xu Da took Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Xu Da captured Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 鄧愈克河州。

translations.literal: Deng Yu captured Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu captured Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔開國時將帥無嗣者祿其家。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict ordered that where founding generals had no heirs, their families should receive stipends.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict ordered that where founding generals had no heirs, their families should receive stipends.

sentences.zh: 是月旱，齋戒，後妃親執爨，皇太子諸王饋於齋所。

translations.literal: That month there was drought; he observed fasting, the empress and consorts personally cooked, and the crown prince and princes brought food to the fasting hall.
translations.idiomatic: That month there was drought; the emperor observed fasting, the empress and consorts cooked in person, and the crown prince and princes brought food to the fasting hall.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，素服草屨，步禱山川壇，露宿凡三日，還齋於西廡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuwu, the first of the month, wearing plain clothes and straw sandals, he walked to pray at the mountain and river altars, sleeping in the open for three days in all, then returned to fast in the western gallery.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, the wuwu day, wearing plain clothes and straw sandals, he walked to pray at the mountain and river altars and slept in the open for three days before returning to fast in the western gallery.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賚將士，省獄囚，命有司訪求通經術明治道者。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, soldiers were rewarded, prisoners in the jails were reviewed, and officials were ordered to seek out those versed in the classics and skilled in governing the Way.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, soldiers were rewarded, prisoners were reviewed, and officials were ordered to seek out those versed in the classics and skilled in governing.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大雨。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李文忠捷奏至，命仕元者勿賀。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Li Wenzhong's victory report arrived; an edict ordered that those who had served the Yuan not offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Li Wenzhong's victory report arrived; an edict ordered that those who had served the Yuan not offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 諡元主曰順帝。

translations.literal: The Yuan ruler was given the posthumous title Emperor Shun.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan ruler was given the posthumous title Emperor Shun.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，買的裏八剌至京師，群臣請獻俘。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Maidilibali reached the capital; the ministers requested to present captives.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Maidilibali reached the capital and the ministers requested a captive presentation.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「武王伐殷用之乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Did King Wu of Zhou use this when he conquered Yin?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Did King Wu use this when he conquered the Shang?"

sentences.zh: 」省臣以唐太宗嘗行之對。

translations.literal: The Secretariat ministers answered that Emperor Taizong of Tang had once done so.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat ministers replied that Emperor Taizong of Tang had once done so.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「太宗是待王世充耳。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Taizong did that for Wang Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Taizong did that for Wang Shichong."

sentences.zh: 若遇隋之子孫，恐不爾也。

translations.literal: Had he encountered a descendant of the Sui, I fear he would not have done so.
translations.idiomatic: Had he met a descendant of the Sui, I doubt he would have done the same."

sentences.zh: 」遂不許。

translations.literal: He thereupon did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon refused.

sentences.zh: 又以捷奏多侈辭，謂宰相曰：「元主中國百年，朕與卿等父母皆賴其生養，奈何為此浮薄之言？

translations.literal: Also, because the victory reports contained much inflated language, he told the chief ministers: "The Yuan ruler held China for a hundred years; I and you alike owe our parents' nurture to him—how can you write such shallow words?"
translations.idiomatic: Also, because the victory reports were full of inflated language, he told the chief ministers: "The Yuan ruled China for a century; you and I alike owe our upbringing to them—how can you write such shallow words?"

sentences.zh: 亟改之。

translations.literal: Change them at once.
translations.idiomatic: Change them at once."

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，封買的裏八剌為崇禮侯。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Maidilibali was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chongli.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Maidilibali was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chongli.

sentences.zh: 丙子，告捷於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, victory was reported at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, victory was reported at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，告太廟，詔示天下。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, victory was reported at the Grand Temple and an edict was promulgated to all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, victory was reported at the Grand Temple and an edict was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徙蘇州、松江、嘉興、湖州、杭州民無業者田臨濠，給資糧牛種，復三年。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, people without occupations in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Hangzhou were relocated to farm fields at Linhuang, given provisions, grain, and oxen, with exemption for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, unemployed people from Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Hangzhou were resettled to farm at Linhuang, given provisions, seed grain, and oxen, with a three-year tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇山東、浙江、福建濱海州縣。

translations.literal: That month, Japanese pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong, Zhejiang, and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Japanese pirates raided the coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong, Zhejiang, and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，明昇將吳友仁寇漢中，參政傅友德擊卻之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day bingchen, Ming Sheng's general Wu Youren attacked Hanzhong; Administrative Commissioner Fu Youde repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingchen day, Ming Sheng's general Wu Youren attacked Hanzhong and Administrative Commissioner Fu Youde repelled him.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞楊憲有罪誅。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Yang Xian was executed for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Yang Xian was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，遣使瘞中原遺骸。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiyou, envoys were dispatched to bury the scattered bones of the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yiyou day, envoys were dispatched to bury the scattered bones of the Central Plains.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，詔儒士更直午門，為武臣講經史。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingchen, an edict ordered Confucian scholars to take turns at the Meridian Gate lecturing the classics and histories to military officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingchen day, an edict ordered Confucian scholars to lecture the classics and histories to military officials at the Meridian Gate in rotation.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，周德興為征南將軍，討覃垕，垕遁。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zhou Dexing was made southern expedition general to attack Tan Hu; Tan Hu fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Zhou Dexing was appointed southern expedition general to attack Tan Hu, who fled.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，貽元嗣君書。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, a letter was sent to the Yuan successor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, a letter was sent to the Yuan successor.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，北征師還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renchen, the northern expedition army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renchen day, the northern expedition army returned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，告武成於郊廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, martial accomplishment was reported at the suburban temples.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, martial accomplishment was reported at the suburban temples.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大封功臣。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, meritorious ministers were greatly enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the founding ministers received great enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 進李善長韓國公，徐達魏國公，封李文忠曹國公，馮勝宋國公，鄧愈衛國公，常遇春子茂鄭國公，湯和等侯者二十八人。

translations.literal: Li Shanchang was advanced to Duke of Han, Xu Da to Duke of Wei; Li Wenzhong was enfeoffed Duke of Cao, Feng Sheng Duke of Song, Deng Yu Duke of Wei, Chang Yuchun's son Mao Duke of Zheng, and Tang He and twenty-eight others were made marquises.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanchang was advanced to Duke of Han and Xu Da to Duke of Wei; Li Wenzhong was enfeoffed Duke of Cao, Feng Sheng Duke of Song, Deng Yu Duke of Wei, Chang Yuchun's son Mao Duke of Zheng, and Tang He and twenty-eight others were made marquises.

sentences.zh: 己亥，設壇親祭戰沒將士。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, an altar was set up and he personally sacrificed to generals who had died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, he set up an altar and personally sacrificed to the generals who had fallen in battle.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, he performed the rites at the Circular Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, he performed the rites at the Circular Altar.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔戶部置戶籍、戶帖，歲計登耗以聞，著為令。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to establish household registers and household placards; annual tallies of increases and decreases were to be reported, established as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to establish household registers and household placards, with annual reports on increases and decreases, codified as a permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，封中書右丞汪廣洋忠勤伯，御史中丞劉基誠意伯。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Right Vice Director Wang Guangyang was enfeoffed as Earl of Zhongqin, and Censor-in-chief Liu Ji as Earl of Chengyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Right Vice Director Wang Guangyang was enfeoffed Earl of Zhongqin and Censor-in-chief Liu Ji Earl of Chengyi.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，復貽元嗣君書，並諭和林諸部。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guihai, he again sent a letter to the Yuan successor and likewise instructed the various tribes of Khara Khoto.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guihai day, he again sent a letter to the Yuan successor and likewise instructed the tribes of Khara Khoto.

sentences.zh: 甲子，建奉先殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Hall for Venerating Ancestors was built.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the Hall for Venerating Ancestors was built.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣使祭歷代帝王陵寢，並加修葺。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mausoleums of emperors through the ages and to repair them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tombs of emperors through the ages and to repair them.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜勳臣田。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, fields were granted to meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, fields were granted to meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以正月至是月，日中屢有黑子，詔廷臣言得失。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, because from the first month to this month black spots had repeatedly appeared on the sun at midday, an edict ordered court ministers to speak of gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, because black spots had repeatedly appeared on the sun at midday from the first month onward, an edict ordered court ministers to speak frankly of what had gone right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、爪哇、西洋入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Java, and the Western Ocean presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Java, and the Western Ocean presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙戌，李善長罷，汪廣洋為右丞相。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the day bingxu, Li Shanchang was dismissed and Wang Guangyang became right grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the bingxu day of the first spring month, Li Shanchang was dismissed and Wang Guangyang became right grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中山侯湯和為征西將軍，江夏侯周德興、德慶侯廖永忠副之，率舟師由瞿塘，潁川侯傅友德為征虜前將軍，濟甯侯顧時副之，率步騎由秦隴伐蜀。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Marquis of Zhongshan Tang He was made western expedition general, with Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing and Marquis of Deqing Liao Yongzhong as deputies, leading a fleet through Qutang; Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde was made forward general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Marquis of Jining Gu Shi as deputy, leading infantry and cavalry through Qin and Long to attack Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Marquis of Zhongshan Tang He was appointed western expedition general with Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing and Marquis of Deqing Liao Yongzhong as deputies, leading a fleet through Qutang; Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde was appointed forward general for the campaign against the barbarians with Marquis of Jining Gu Shi as deputy, leading infantry and cavalry through Qin and Long to attack Shu.

sentences.zh: 魏國公徐達練兵北平。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Xu Da trained troops at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Wei Xu Da trained troops at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 戊子，衛國公鄧愈督餉給征蜀軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Duke of Wei Deng Yu supervised provisions for the army attacking Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Duke of Wei Deng Yu supervised provisions for the army attacking Shu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，建郊廟於中都。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, suburban altars were built at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, suburban altars were built at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔設科取士，連舉三年，嗣後三年一舉。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, an edict established the civil service examination, to be held three years in succession, and thereafter once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, an edict established the civil service examination, to be held three years in succession and thereafter once every three years.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免山西旱災田租。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, land tax on drought-stricken fields in Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, land tax on drought-stricken fields in Shanxi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，幸中都。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiaxu, he visited the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiaxu day, he visited the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自中都。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he returned from the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, he returned from the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 元平章劉益以遼東降。

translations.literal: Yuan Pingzhang Liu Yi surrendered with Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Pingzhang Liu Yi surrendered with Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲太平、鎮江、甯國田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax in Taiping, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax in Taiping, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉朔，始策試天下貢士，賜吳伯宗等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yiyou, the first of the month, the palace examination of tribute scholars from throughout the realm began; Wu Bozong and others were granted jinshi with rank of first class and lower ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, the yiyou day, the palace examination of tribute scholars from across the realm began; Wu Bozong and others were granted the jinshi degree with distinctions of rank.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，徙山後民萬七千戶屯北平。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, seventeen thousand households of people from beyond the mountains were relocated to garrison Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, seventeen thousand households from beyond the mountains were relocated to garrison Beiping.

sentences.zh: 丁未，誠意伯劉基致仕。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Earl of Chengyi Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Earl of Chengyi Liu Ji retired from office.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，傅友德克階州，文、隆、綿三州相繼下。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day bingxu, Fu Youde captured Jiezhou; Wen, Long, and Mian prefectures fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingxu day, Fu Youde captured Jiezhou, and Wen, Long, and Mian prefectures fell in succession.

sentences.zh: 五月，免江西、浙江秋糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, autumn grain tax in Jiangxi and Zhejiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, autumn grain tax in Jiangxi and Zhejiang was remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，傅友德克漢州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renwu, Fu Youde captured Hanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renwu day, Fu Youde captured Hanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廖永忠克夔州。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Liao Yongzhong captured Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Liao Yongzhong captured Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，明昇將丁世貞破文州，守將硃顯忠死之。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Ming Sheng's general Ding Shizhen broke Wenzhou; defending general Zhu Xianzhong died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Ming Sheng's general Ding Shizhen captured Wenzhou, and defending general Zhu Xianzhong died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，湯和至重慶，明昇降。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Tang He reached Chongqing and Ming Sheng surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Tang He reached Chongqing and Ming Sheng surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊申，倭寇膠州。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Japanese pirates raided Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Japanese pirates raided Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，徙山後民三萬五千戶於內地，又徙沙漠遺民三萬二千戶屯田北平。

translations.literal: That month, thirty-five thousand households from beyond the mountains were relocated to the interior, and thirty-two thousand desert refugees were also relocated to farm fields at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: That month, thirty-five thousand households from beyond the mountains were relocated inland, and thirty-two thousand refugees from the desert were resettled to farm at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，徐達練兵山西。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinhai, Xu Da trained troops in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinhai day, Xu Da trained troops in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，傅友德下成都，四川平。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Fu Youde took Chengdu and Sichuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Fu Youde took Chengdu and Sichuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，明昇至京師，封歸義侯。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Ming Sheng reached the capital and was enfeoffed Marquis of Guiyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Ming Sheng reached the capital and was enfeoffed Marquis of Guiyi.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，免中都、淮、揚及泰、滁、無為田租。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiawu, land tax in the Central Capital, Huai, Yang, and Tai, Chu, and Wuzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiawu day, land tax in the Central Capital, Huai, Yang, Tai, Chu, and Wuzhou was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己酉，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, famine in Shaanxi was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, famine in Shaanxi was relieved.

sentences.zh: 是月，高州海寇亂，通判王名善死之。

translations.literal: That month, sea bandits at Gaozhou rebelled; Vice Commissioner Wang Mingshan died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: That month, sea bandits at Gaozhou rebelled and Vice Commissioner Wang Mingshan died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengxu, the first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, the gengxu day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，征蜀師還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingshen, the army attacking Shu returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingshen day, the army that had attacked Shu returned.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingchen, he performed the rites at the Circular Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingchen day, he performed the rites at the Circular Altar.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命官吏犯贓者罪勿貸。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, an edict ordered that officials guilty of corruption were not to be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict ordered that officials guilty of corruption were not to be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西、河南被災田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Shaanxi and Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Shaanxi and Henan was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，徐達還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、浡泥、高麗、三佛齊、暹羅、日本、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annan, Poni, Goryeo, Sanfoqi, Siam, Japan, and Zhenla presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Annan, Poni, Goryeo, Sanfoqi, Siam, Japan, and Zhenla presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸丑，待制王禕使雲南，詔諭元梁王把匝剌瓦爾密。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day guichou, Academician Wang Yi was sent as envoy to Yunnan with an edict instructing the Yuan Prince of Liang Bazhila'ermi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the guichou day of the first spring month, Academician Wang Yi was sent as envoy to Yunnan with an edict instructing the Yuan Prince of Liang Bazhila'ermi.

sentences.zh: 禕至，不屈死。

translations.literal: When Yi arrived, he refused to submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Yi arrived, he refused to submit and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，徙陳理、明升於高麗。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Chen Li and Ming Sheng were relocated to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Chen Li and Ming Sheng were relocated to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，魏國公徐達為征虜大將軍，出雁門，趨和林，曹國公李文忠為左副將軍，出應昌，宋國公馮勝為征西將軍，取甘肅，征擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Duke of Wei Xu Da was made great general for the campaign against the barbarians, marching out of Yanmen toward Khara Khoto; Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong was left deputy general, marching out of Yingchang; Duke of Song Feng Sheng was western expedition general to take Gansu and campaign against Köke Temür.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Duke of Wei Xu Da was appointed great general for the campaign against the barbarians, marching out of Yanmen toward Khara Khoto; Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong was left deputy general, marching out of Yingchang; Duke of Song Feng Sheng was western expedition general to take Gansu and campaign against Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 靖海侯吳禎督海運，餉遼東。

translations.literal: Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen supervised sea transport to supply Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen supervised sea transport to supply Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 衛國公鄧愈為征南將軍，江夏侯周德興、江陰侯吳良副之，分道討湖南、廣西洞蠻。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Deng Yu was southern expedition general, with Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing and Marquis of Jiangyin Wu Liang as deputies, advancing by separate routes to attack the cave barbarians of Hunan and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Wei Deng Yu was appointed southern expedition general with Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing and Marquis of Jiangyin Wu Liang as deputies, advancing by separate routes against the cave barbarians of Hunan and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，安南陳叔明弒其主日熞自立，遣使入貢，卻之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day bingxu, Chen Shuming of Annan murdered his lord Riri and installed himself; he sent envoys presenting tribute, which was declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingxu day, Chen Shuming of Annan murdered his lord Riri and seized power; he sent envoys with tribute, which was declined.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，都督僉事藍玉敗擴廓於土剌河。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingmao, Commissioner-in-chief Lan Yu defeated Köke at the Tula River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingmao day, Commissioner-in-chief Lan Yu defeated Köke at the Tula River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，振濟南、萊州饑。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jimao, famine in Jinan and Laizhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jimao day, famine in Jinan and Laizhou was relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，始行鄉飲酒禮。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the village drinking ceremony was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the village drinking ceremony was first performed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈平散毛諸洞蠻。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Deng Yu pacified the cave barbarians of Sanmao and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Deng Yu pacified the cave barbarians of Sanmao and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，徐達及元兵戰於嶺北，敗績。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renzi, Xu Da fought Yuan forces north of the ranges and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renzi day, Xu Da fought Yuan forces north of the ranges and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔曰：「天下大定，禮儀風俗不可不正。

translations.literal: That month, an edict said: "All-under-Heaven is greatly settled; ritual and custom must be rectified.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict proclaimed: "The realm is now largely settled; ritual and custom must be set right."

sentences.zh: 諸遭亂為人奴隸者復為民。

translations.literal: Those who had become slaves through disorder were restored to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had been enslaved during the turmoil were restored to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 凍餒者里中富室假貸之，孤寡殘疾者官養之，毋失所。

translations.literal: Those suffering from cold and hunger were to be lent to by wealthy households in the village; orphans, widows, and the disabled were to be supported by the government so that none were left without support.
translations.idiomatic: Those suffering from cold and hunger were to be lent to by wealthy households in the village; orphans, widows, and the disabled were to be supported by the government so that none were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 鄉黨論齒，相見揖拜，毋違禮。

translations.literal: In the village, age was discussed in determining precedence; on meeting, bow and salute—do not violate ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the village, precedence was determined by age; on meeting, people were to bow and salute without violating ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 婚姻毋論財。

translations.literal: In marriage, do not discuss wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Marriages were not to be arranged on the basis of wealth.

sentences.zh: 喪事稱家有無，毋惑陰陽拘忌，停柩暴露。

translations.literal: In funerals, scale according to what the family has; do not be misled by yin-yang taboos and leave the coffin exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Funerals were to be conducted according to what a family could afford, without being misled by yin-yang taboos into leaving coffins exposed.

sentences.zh: 流民復業者各就丁力耕種，毋以舊田為限。

translations.literal: Wandering people returning to their occupations were each to farm according to their labor power; the old fields were not to be taken as the limit.
translations.idiomatic: Returning refugees were each to farm according to their labor, without being limited to their former holdings.

sentences.zh: 僧道齋醮雜男女，恣飲食，有司嚴治之。

translations.literal: Buddhist and Daoist fasting assemblies mixing men and women and indulging in food and drink were to be strictly punished by officials.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist and Daoist assemblies that mixed men and women and indulged in feasting were to be strictly punished.

sentences.zh: 閩、粵豪家毋閹人子為火者，犯者抵罪。

translations.literal: In Fujian and Guangdong, powerful families were not to castrate boys as fire-keepers; violators were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In Fujian and Guangdong, powerful families were forbidden to castrate boys as fire-keepers; violators were punished according to law."

sentences.zh: 」六月丙子，定宦官禁令。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingzi, prohibitions on eunuchs were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingzi day, prohibitions on eunuchs were codified.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定宮官女職之制。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the system of palace women and female offices was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the system of palace women and female offices was established.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，馮勝克甘肅，追敗元兵於瓜、沙州。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Feng Sheng captured Gansu and pursued and defeated Yuan forces at Guazhou and Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Feng Sheng captured Gansu and pursued and defeated Yuan forces at Guazhou and Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，定六部職掌及歲終考績法。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the duties of the Six Ministries and the year-end performance review law were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the duties of the Six Ministries and the year-end performance review law were established.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，吳良平靖州蠻。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李文忠敗元兵於阿魯渾河，宣甯侯曹良臣戰沒。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan forces on the Aru River; Marquis of Xuanning Cao Liangchen died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan forces on the Aru River; Marquis of Xuanning Cao Liangchen died in battle.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，作鐵榜誡功臣。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an iron tablet was made to admonish the meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, an iron tablet was cast to admonish the meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 是月，振山東饑，免被災郡縣田租。

translations.literal: That month, famine in Shandong was relieved and land tax in disaster-stricken prefectures and counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, famine in Shandong was relieved and land tax in disaster-stricken prefectures and counties was remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，湯和及元兵戰於斷頭山，敗績。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day bingchen, Tang He fought Yuan forces at Broken Head Mountain and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingchen day, Tang He fought Yuan forces at Broken Head Mountain and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，吳良平五開、古州諸蠻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingshen, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Wukai, Guzhou, and elsewhere.
