translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingshen day, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Wukai, Guzhou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，元兵犯雲內，同知黃里死之。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Yuan forces invaded Yunnei; Vice Commissioner Huang Li died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Yuan forces invaded Yunnei and Vice Commissioner Huang Li died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，周德興平婪鳳、安田諸蠻。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wuwu, Zhou Dexing pacified the barbarians of Lanfeng, Antian, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuwu day, Zhou Dexing pacified the barbarians of Lanfeng, Antian, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，馮勝師還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingyou, Feng Sheng's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingyou day, Feng Sheng's army returned.

sentences.zh: 是月，免應天、太平、鎮江、甯國、廣德田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax in Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax in Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinyou, he performed the rites at the Circular Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinyou day, he performed the rites at the Circular Altar.

sentences.zh: 甲子，征南師還。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the southern expedition army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the southern expedition army returned.

sentences.zh: 壬申，納哈出犯遼東。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Naghachu attacked Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Naghachu attacked Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，召徐達、李文忠還。

translations.literal: That month, Xu Da and Li Wenzhong were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xu Da and Li Wenzhong were recalled.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，詔以農桑學校課有司。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, an edict ordered that agriculture, sericulture, and schools be made the measure of officials' performance.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiaxu day, an edict ordered that agriculture, sericulture, and schools be made the measure of officials' performance.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命百官奏事啟皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, all officials presenting memorials were ordered to inform the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, all officials presenting memorials were ordered to inform the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈為征西將軍，征吐番。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Deng Yu was made western expedition general to campaign against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Deng Yu was appointed western expedition general to campaign against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，貽元嗣君書。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, a letter was sent to the Yuan successor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, a letter was sent to the Yuan successor.

sentences.zh: 是年，瑣里、占城、高麗、琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Suoli, Champa, Goryeo, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Suoli, Champa, Goryeo, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 高麗貢使再至，諭自後三年一貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo tribute envoys arrived a second time; they were instructed that henceforth tribute would be once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo tribute envoys arrived a second time; they were instructed that henceforth tribute would be presented once every three years.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲寅，謫汪廣洋為廣東參政。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the day jiayin, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Administrative Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the jiayin day of the first spring month, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Administrative Commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，諭暫罷科舉，察舉賢才。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yiwei, an edict ordered the civil service examination temporarily suspended and worthy talent sought by recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yiwei day, an edict ordered the civil service examination temporarily suspended and worthy talent sought by recommendation.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命御史及按察使考察有司。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, censors and surveillance commissioners were ordered to investigate local officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, censors and surveillance commissioners were ordered to investigate local officials.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guimao, the first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, the guimao day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 頒《昭鑒錄》，訓誡諸王。

translations.literal: The Mirror for Reflection Record was promulgated to instruct and admonish the princes.
translations.idiomatic: The Mirror for Reflection Record was promulgated to instruct and admonish the princes.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太閱。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, a great military review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, a great military review was held.

sentences.zh: 壬子，徐達為征虜大將軍，李文忠、馮勝、鄧愈、湯和副之，備邊山西、北平。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Xu Da was made great general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as deputies, to guard the borders of Shanxi and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Xu Da was appointed great general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as deputies, to guard the borders of Shanxi and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 甲子，指揮使於顯為總兵官，備倭。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Commander Yu Xian was made commander-in-chief to guard against the Japanese.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Commander Yu Xian was appointed commander-in-chief to guard against Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，令有司上山川險易圖。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jichou, officials were ordered to submit maps of mountains and rivers showing strategic terrain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jichou day, officials were ordered to submit maps of mountains and rivers showing strategic terrain.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，盱眙獻瑞麥，薦宗廟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renwu, Xuyi presented auspicious wheat, which was offered at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renwu day, Xuyi presented auspicious wheat, which was offered at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，擴廓帖木兒遣兵攻雁門，指揮吳均擊卻之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Köke Temür dispatched troops to attack Yanmen; Commander Wu Jun repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Köke Temür dispatched troops to attack Yanmen, and Commander Wu Jun repelled them.

sentences.zh: 是月，免北平、河間、河南、開封、延安、汾州被災田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Beiping, Hejian, Henan, Kaifeng, Yan'an, and Fenzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Beiping, Hejian, Henan, Kaifeng, Yan'an, and Fenzhou was remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，命戶部稽渡江以來各省水旱災傷分數，優恤之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renyin, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to verify the proportions of flood, drought, and disaster damage in each province since the crossing of the Yangzi, and to grant preferential relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renyin day, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to verify flood, drought, and disaster damage in each province since the crossing of the Yangzi and grant preferential relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，胡惟庸為右丞相，八月乙亥，詔祀三皇及歷代帝王。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Hu Weiyong became right grand councilor; in the eighth month, on the day yihai, an edict ordered sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns and emperors through the ages.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Hu Weiyong became right grand councilor; in the eighth month, on the yihai day, an edict ordered sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns and emperors through the ages.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，召徐達、馮勝還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day xinsi, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinsi day, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，擴廓帖木兒犯大同，徐達遣將擊敗之，達仍留鎮。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day xinsi, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinsi day, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣兵部尚書劉仁振真定饑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renzi, Köke Temür invaded Datong; Xu Da dispatched generals who defeated him, and Xu Da remained to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renzi day, Köke Temür invaded Datong; Xu Da's generals defeated him, and Xu Da remained to garrison the region.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，冬至，帝不豫，改卜郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Minister of War Liu Ren was dispatched to relieve famine in Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Minister of War Liu Ren was dispatched to relieve famine in Zhending.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，錄故功臣子孫未嗣者二百九人。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the winter solstice—the emperor was unwell and the suburban sacrifice was postponed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the winter solstice—the emperor was unwell and the suburban sacrifice was postponed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he performed the rites at the Circular Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, he performed the rites at the Circular Altar.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，頒定《大明律》。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the Great Ming Code was promulgated in fixed form.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the Great Ming Code was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、高麗、占城、真臘、三佛齊入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Goryeo, Champa, Zhenla, and Sanfoqi presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Siam, Goryeo, Champa, Zhenla, and Sanfoqi presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 命安南陳叔明權知國事。

translations.literal: Chen Shuming of Annan was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shuming of Annan was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲戌，都督僉事王簡、王誠、平章李伯升屯田河南、山東、北平。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the day jiaxu, Commissioner-in-chief Wang Jian, Wang Cheng, and Pingzhang Li Bosheng garrisoned fields in Henan, Shandong, and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu day of the first spring month, Commissioners-in-chief Wang Jian and Wang Cheng and Pingzhang Li Bosheng established garrison farms in Henan, Shandong, and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 靖海侯吳禎為總兵官，都督於顯副之，巡海捕倭。

translations.literal: Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen was made commander-in-chief, with Commissioner Yu Xian as deputy, patrolling the seas to capture Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen was appointed commander-in-chief with Commissioner Yu Xian as deputy to patrol the seas and capture Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，日有食之。

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣都督同知沐英乘傳詣陝西問民疾苦。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Commissioner of the Second Rank Mu Ying was dispatched by express post to Shaanxi to inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Commissioner of the Second Rank Mu Ying was dispatched by express post to Shaanxi to inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 是年，覽邦、琉球、安南、日本、烏斯藏、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Lanbang, Ryukyu, Annan, Japan, U-Tsang, and Goryeo presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Lanbang, Ryukyu, Annan, Japan, U-Tsang, and Goryeo presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛卯，以羽林等衛軍益秦、晉、燕三府護衛。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the day xinmao, guards from the Feathered Forest and other guards were added to the protective establishments of the Qin, Jin, and Yan princes.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the xinmao day of the first spring month, guards from the Feathered Forest and other guards were added to the protective establishments of the Qin, Jin, and Yan princes.

sentences.zh: 是春，振蘇、松、嘉、湖水災。

translations.literal: That spring, flood disaster in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, flood disaster in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was relieved.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，鄧愈為征西將軍，沐英為副將軍，率師討吐番，大破之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiyou, Deng Yu was western expedition general and Mu Ying deputy general; they led an army to attack Tibet and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiyou day, Deng Yu was appointed western expedition general with Mu Ying as deputy; they led an army against Tibet and inflicted a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 是月，振太平、甯國及宜興、錢塘諸縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in Taiping, Ningguo, and the counties of Yixing and Qiantang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood disaster in Taiping, Ningguo, and the counties of Yixing and Qiantang was relieved.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，韓國公李善長、曹國公李文忠總中書省、大都督府、御史台，議軍國重事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengzi, Duke of Han Li Shanchang and Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong jointly directed the Secretariat, the Chief Military Commission, and the Censorate to deliberate on weighty matters of state and army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengzi day, Duke of Han Li Shanchang and Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong jointly directed the Secretariat, the Chief Military Commission, and the Censorate to deliberate on weighty matters of state and army.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，振湖廣水災。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, flood disaster in Huguang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, flood disaster in Huguang was relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙午，戶部主事趙乾振荊、蘄遲緩，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Ministry of Revenue clerk Zhao Gan, for sluggishness in relief of Jing and Qi, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Zhao Gan, a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue, was executed for the tardiness of his famine relief efforts in Jing and Qi.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，詔臣民言事者，實封達御前。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingsi, an edict ordered that those among officials and commoners who speak on affairs submit sealed petitions directly before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingsi day, an edict ordered that officials and commoners who wished to report affairs submit sealed memorials to reach the throne directly.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命政事啟皇太子裁決奏聞。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, government affairs were ordered to be opened to the crown prince for decision and reported back.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, government affairs were ordered to be submitted to the crown prince for decision and then reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，置通政司。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day jiashen, the Office of Transmission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiashen day, the Office of Transmission was established.

sentences.zh: 是月，始遣御史巡按州縣。

translations.literal: That month, censors were first dispatched to inspect prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month, censors were first dispatched on inspection tours of prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，改建大祀殿於南郊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengxu, the Hall of Great Sacrifice was rebuilt at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengxu day, the Hall of Great Sacrifice was rebuilt at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，選武臣子弟讀書國子監。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, sons of military officers were selected to study at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, sons of military officers were selected to study at the National University.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，振紹興、金華、衢州水災。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingshen, flood disaster in Shaoxing, Jinhua, and Quzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingshen day, flood disaster in Shaoxing, Jinhua, and Quzhou was relieved.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，胡惟庸為左丞相，汪廣洋為右丞相。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Hu Weiyong was made left grand councilor and Wang Guangyang right grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Hu Weiyong was appointed left grand councilor and Wang Guangyang right grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，封沐英四平侯。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day wuwu, Mu Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Siping.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the wuwu day, Mu Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Siping.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜百官公田。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, public fields were granted to officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, public fields were granted to officials.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，衛國公鄧愈卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guiwei, Duke of Wei Deng Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guiwei day, Duke of Wei Deng Yu died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，合祀天地於奉天殿。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to in the Hall of Reverence for Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to in the Hall of Reverence for Heaven.

sentences.zh: 是月，免河南、陝西、廣東、湖廣田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax in Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax in Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and Huguang was remitted.

sentences.zh: 威茂蠻叛，御史大夫丁玉為平羌將軍，討平之。

translations.literal: The Weimao tribes rebelled; Censor-in-chief Ding Yu was made Pacification General of the Qiang and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: The Weimao tribes rebelled; Censor-in-chief Ding Yu was appointed Pacification General of the Qiang and put down the rising.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day yisi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the first day of the month, yisi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁未，錄故功臣子孫百百餘人，授官有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, more than one hundred descendants of deceased meritorious officials were registered and appointed to offices of varying rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, over one hundred descendants of deceased meritorious officials were registered and appointed to offices of varying rank.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、三佛齊、暹羅、爪哇、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Srivijaya, Siam, Java, and Cambodia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Srivijaya, Siam, Java, and Cambodia sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 高麗使五至，以嗣王未立，卻之。

translations.literal: Korean envoys came five times; because the successor king had not yet been enthroned, they were turned away.
translations.idiomatic: Korean envoys arrived five times; because no successor king had yet been enthroned, they were turned away.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月甲戌，封皇子椿為蜀王，柏湘王，桂豫王，模漢王，植衛王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, first month, on the day jiaxu, the princes Chun, Bai, Gui, Mo, and Zhi were enfeoffed as Princes of Shu, Xiang, Yu, Han, and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on the jiaxu day of the first spring month, Prince Chun was enfeoffed as Prince of Shu, Prince Bai as Prince of Xiang, Prince Gui as Prince of Yu, Prince Mo as Prince of Han, and Prince Zhi as Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 改封吳王橚為周王。

translations.literal: Prince of Wu Zhu Shu was changed to Prince of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wu Zhu Shu was reassigned as Prince of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，進封湯和信國公。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Tang He was advanced to Duke of the State of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Tang He was promoted to Duke of the State of Xin.

sentences.zh: 是月，徵天下布政使及知府來朝。

translations.literal: That month, provincial administrators and prefectural magistrates throughout the realm were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month, provincial administrators and prefectural magistrates from throughout the realm were summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 二月，指揮胡淵平茂州蠻。

translations.literal: In the second month, Commander Hu Yuan pacified the Maozhou tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Commander Hu Yuan pacified the Maozhou tribes.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，命奏事毋關白中書省。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renwu, memorials were ordered not to be routed through clearance by the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renwu day, memorials were ordered to bypass the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，第來朝官為三等。

translations.literal: That month, arriving officials were ranked in three grades.
translations.idiomatic: That month, officials who had come to court were ranked in three grades.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，元嗣君愛猷識理達臘殂，子脫古思帖木兒嗣。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the Yuan heir Ayurshiridara died; his son Toghus Temür succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, the Yuan heir Ayurshiridara died and was succeeded by his son Toghus Temür.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，存問蘇、松、嘉、湖被水災民，戶賜米一石，蠲逋賦六十五萬有奇。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingyou, the people of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou afflicted by flood were inquired after; one picul of grain was granted per household, and more than 650,000 in arrears were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingyou day, officials inquired after flood victims in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou, granting one picul of grain per household and remitting more than 650,000 in arrears.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，遣使祭故元嗣君。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renzi, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the deceased Yuan heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renzi day, envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial rites for the deceased Yuan heir.

sentences.zh: 己巳，五開蠻叛，殺靖州指揮過興，以辰州指揮楊仲名為總兵官，討之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Wukai tribes rebelled and killed Jingzhou commander Guo Xing; Chenzhou commander Yang Zhongming was made supreme commander to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the Wukai tribes rebelled and killed Jingzhou commander Guo Xing; Chenzhou commander Yang Zhongming was appointed supreme commander to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，振平陽饑。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day dingchou, famine in Pingyang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingchou day, famine relief was extended in Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，蘇、松、揚、臺海溢，遣官存恤。

translations.literal: That month, Suzhou, Songjiang, Yangzhou, and Taizhou overflowed; officials were dispatched to inquire after and comfort the people.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flooding overflowed in Suzhou, Songjiang, Yangzhou, and Taizhou; officials were sent to investigate and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 八月，免應天、太平、鎮江、甯國、廣德諸府州秋糧。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, autumn grain tax in the prefectures and districts of Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, autumn grain tax was remitted in Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde prefectures and districts.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，追封劉繼祖為義惠侯。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingshen, Liu Jizu was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yihui.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingshen day, Liu Jizu was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yihui.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，大祀殿成。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiazi, the Hall of Great Sacrifice was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiazi day, the Hall of Great Sacrifice was completed.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，征西將軍西平侯沐英率都督藍玉、玉弼討西番。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengwu, Western expedition general Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping, led commanders Lan Yu and Yu Bi to attack the western tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengwu day, Western expedition general Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping, led commanders Lan Yu and Yu Bi against the western tribes.

sentences.zh: 是月，五開蠻平。

translations.literal: That month, the Wukai tribes were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Wukai rebellion was pacified.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、闍婆、高麗、琉球、占城、三佛齊、朵甘、烏斯藏、彭亨、百花入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Java, Korea, Ryukyu, Champa, Srivijaya, Doker, U-Tsang, Pahang, and Baihua sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Siam, Java, Korea, Ryukyu, Champa, Srivijaya, Doker, U-Tsang, Pahang, and Baihua sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月己卯，始合禮天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, first month, on the day jimao, Heaven and Earth were first jointly sacrificed to at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, on the jimao day of the first spring month, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the southern suburb for the first time.

sentences.zh: 甲申，洮州十八族番叛，命沐英移兵討之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the eighteen tribes of Taozhou rebelled; Mu Ying was ordered to transfer troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the eighteen tribes of Taozhou rebelled; Mu Ying was ordered to transfer his forces to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，丁玉平松州蠻。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Ding Yu pacified the Songzhou tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Ding Yu pacified the Songzhou tribes.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，李文忠督理河、岷、臨、鞏軍事。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuxu, Li Wenzhong was put in overall charge of military affairs in He, Min, Lin, and Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuxu day, Li Wenzhong was placed in overall charge of military affairs in He, Min, Lin, and Gong.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔曰：「今春雨雪經旬。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict said: "This spring rain and snow have continued for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, an edict said: "This spring, rain and snow have continued for ten days.

sentences.zh: 天下貧民困於饑寒者多有，其令有司給以鈔。

translations.literal: Among the poor throughout the realm, many are afflicted by hunger and cold; let the responsible offices be ordered to grant them paper currency."
translations.idiomatic: Many poor people throughout the realm are suffering from hunger and cold; let the responsible offices be ordered to grant them paper currency."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，信國公湯和率列候練兵臨清。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Duke of the State of Xin Tang He led the ranked marquises to drill troops at Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Duke of the State of Xin Tang He led the ranked marquises to drill troops at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，蠲北平田租。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the day guiwei, land tax in Beiping was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the guiwei day, land tax in Beiping was remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，都督馬雲征大寧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, Commander Ma Yun campaigned against Daning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingmao day, Commander Ma Yun campaigned against Daning.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，丁玉回師討眉縣賊，平之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day bingchen, Ding Yu returned his army, attacked bandits in Mei county, and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingchen day, Ding Yu returned his army, attacked bandits in Mei county, and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 己未，李文忠還掌大都督府事。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Li Wenzhong resumed direction of the Chief Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Li Wenzhong resumed direction of the Chief Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，詔凡致仕官復其家，終身無所與。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinsi, an edict ordered that all retired officials have their households restored and owe nothing for life.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinsi day, an edict ordered that retired officials have their households exempted and owe nothing for life.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，沐英大破西番，擒其部長三副使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jihai, Mu Ying inflicted a great defeat on the western tribes and captured three of their deputy chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jihai day, Mu Ying inflicted a great defeat on the western tribes and captured three of their deputy chiefs.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲午，沐英班師，封仇成、藍玉等十二人為侯。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day jiawu, Mu Ying returned his army; Qiu Cheng, Lan Yu, and twelve others were enfeoffed as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the jiawu day, Mu Ying returned his army; Qiu Cheng, Lan Yu, and twelve others were enfeoffed as marquises.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大寧平。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Daning was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Daning was pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月，汪廣洋貶廣南，賜死。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Guangnan and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Guangnan and ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 徵天下博學老成之士至京師。

translations.literal: Learned and elderly scholars throughout the realm were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Learned and elderly scholars from throughout the realm were summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、爪哇、暹羅、日本、安南、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Java, Siam, Japan, Annam, and Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Java, Siam, Japan, Annam, and Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 高麗貢黃金百斤、白金萬兩，以不如約，卻之。

translations.literal: Korea presented one hundred jin of gold and ten thousand taels of silver; because it did not conform to the agreement, the tribute was declined.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented one hundred jin of gold and ten thousand taels of silver; because the gift did not conform to the agreement, it was declined.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月戊戌，左丞相胡惟庸謀反，及其黨御史大夫陳甯、中丞塗節等伏誅。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, first month, on the day wuxu, Left Grand Councilor Hu Weiyong plotted rebellion; he and his partisans Censor-in-chief Chen Ning, Vice Censor-in-chief Tu Jie, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, on the wuxu day of the first spring month, Left Grand Councilor Hu Weiyong plotted rebellion; he and his partisans Censor-in-chief Chen Ning, Vice Censor-in-chief Tu Jie, and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 罷中書省，廢丞相等官，更定六部官秩，改大都督府為中、左、右、前、後五軍都督府。

translations.literal: The Secretariat was abolished, the offices of grand councilor and the like were eliminated, the ranks of the Six Ministries were revised, and the Chief Military Commission was changed into the five military commissions of Central, Left, Right, Front, and Rear.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was abolished, the offices of grand councilor and the like were eliminated, the ranks of the Six Ministries were revised, and the Chief Military Commission was restructured into five military commissions: Central, Left, Right, Front, and Rear.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌朔，詔舉聰明正直、孝弟力田、賢良方正、文學術數之士。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day renxu, an edict summoned men of discernment and integrity, filial piety and diligence in farming, eminent virtue and upright character, and those skilled in letters and calculations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the first day of the month, renxu, an edict summoned men of discernment and integrity, filial piety and diligence in farming, eminent virtue and upright character, and those skilled in letters and calculations.

sentences.zh: 發丹符，驗天下金穀之數。

translations.literal: Red tally tokens were issued to verify the counts of gold and grain throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Red tally tokens were issued to audit grain and treasure counts throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，文武官年六十以上者聽致仕，給以誥敕。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, civil and military officials aged sixty or above were permitted to retire and were granted patent letters of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, civil and military officials aged sixty or above were permitted to retire and were granted patent letters of appointment.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，減蘇、松、嘉、湖重賦十之二。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renchen, the heavy levies of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou were reduced by two-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renchen day, the heavy levies of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou were reduced by two-tenths.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，燕王隸之國北平。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Prince of Yan took up residence in his princely domain at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the Prince of Yan went to his fief at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 壬子，沐英襲元將脫火赤於亦集乃，擒之，盡降其眾。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Mu Ying raided the Yuan general Tuo Huochi at Yijinai, captured him, and all his forces surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Mu Ying raided the Yuan general Tuo Huochi at Yijinai, captured him, and all his forces surrendered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，命群臣各舉所知。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jichou, officials and ministers were ordered each to recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jichou day, officials and ministers were ordered each to recommend men they knew.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，雷震謹身殿。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiawu, lightning struck the Hall of Vigilance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiawu day, lightning struck the Hall of Vigilance.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，釋在京及臨濠屯田輸作者。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, corvée laborers doing transport work at the capital and Linhuang garrison farms were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, corvée laborers at the capital and Linhuang garrison farms were released.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免天下田租。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, land tax throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, land tax throughout the realm was remitted.

sentences.zh: 吏以過誤罷者還其職。

translations.literal: Clerks dismissed for minor errors were restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks dismissed for minor errors were restored to office.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，都督濮英進兵赤斤站，獲故元豳王亦憐真及其部曲而還。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Commander Pu Ying advanced to Chijin Station, captured the former Yuan Prince of Bin Yilianzhen and his following, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Commander Pu Ying advanced to Chijin Station, captured the former Yuan Prince of Bin Yilianzhen and his followers, and returned.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷御史台。

translations.literal: That month, the Censorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Censorate was abolished.

sentences.zh: 命從征士卒老疾者許以子代，老而無子及寡婦，有司資遣還。

translations.literal: Soldiers on campaign who were aged or ill were permitted to send sons in their stead; those old without sons and widows were provided for and sent home by the offices.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign soldiers who were aged or ill were permitted to send sons in their stead; those who were old and without sons, and widows, were provided for and sent home by the offices.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，雷震奉天門，避正殿省愆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingyin, lightning struck the Gate of Reverence for Heaven; the emperor left the main hall and examined his faults.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingyin day, lightning struck the Gate of Reverence for Heaven; the emperor left the main hall and examined his faults.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷王府工役。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, corvée labor on princely establishments was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, corvée labor on princely establishments was halted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，置諫院官。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, remonstrance officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, remonstrance officials were established.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，命天下學校師生，日給廩膳。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, teachers and students in schools throughout the realm were granted daily grain stipends.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, teachers and students in schools throughout the realm were granted daily grain stipends.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，景川侯曹震、營陽侯楊璟、永城侯恭顯屯田北平。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinmao, Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, Marquis of Yingyang Yang Jing, and Marquis of Yongcheng Gong Xian undertook garrison farming in Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinmao day, Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, Marquis of Yingyang Yang Jing, and Marquis of Yongcheng Gong Xian undertook garrison farming in Beiping.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天壽節，始受群臣朝賀，賜宴於謹身殿，後以為常。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the emperor's birthday; the court for the first time received the congratulations of officials and granted a feast in the Hall of Vigilance—afterward this became regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the emperor's birthday, the court for the first time received congratulations from officials and granted a feast in the Hall of Vigilance; afterward this became regular practice.

sentences.zh: 丙午，置四輔官，告於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Four Assisting Officials were established and the matter was announced at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Four Assisting Officials were established and the matter was announced at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 以儒士王本、估佑、襲斅、杜斅、趙民望、吳源為春、夏官。

translations.literal: Confucian scholars Wang Ben, Gu You, Xi Jiao, Du Jiao, Zhao Minwang, and Wu Yuan were appointed as Spring and Summer officials.
translations.idiomatic: Confucian scholars Wang Ben, Gu You, Xi Jiao, Du Jiao, Zhao Minwang, and Wu Yuan were appointed as Spring and Summer officials.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔陝西衛軍以三分之二屯田。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered Shaanxi guard troops to farm land with two-thirds of their strength.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict ordered Shaanxi guard troops to devote two-thirds of their strength to garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 安置翰林學士承旨宋濂於茂州，道卒。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician-expositor Song Lian was sent to Maozhou; he died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician-expositor Song Lian was sent to Maozhou and died on the way.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙未，徐達還。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day yiwei, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the yiwei day, Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 丙午，元平章完者不花、乃兒不花犯永平，指揮劉廣戰沒，千戶王輅擊敗之，擒完者不花。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, former Yuan Pingzhang Wan Zhebuhua and Na'erbuhua attacked Yongping; Commander Liu Guang fell in battle; Wagon Master Wang Lu defeated them and captured Wan Zhebuhua.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, former Yuan Pingzhang Wan Zhebuhua and Na'erbuhua attacked Yongping; Commander Liu Guang fell in battle, but Wagon Master Wang Lu defeated them and captured Wan Zhebuhua.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天下府州縣所舉士至者八百六十餘人，授官有差。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, more than eight hundred sixty scholars recommended by prefectures, districts, and counties throughout the realm arrived and were appointed to offices of varying rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, over eight hundred sixty scholars recommended by prefectures, districts, and counties throughout the realm arrived and were appointed to offices of varying rank.

sentences.zh: 南雄侯趙庸鎮廣東，討陽春蠻。

translations.literal: Marquis of Nanxiong Zhao Yong garrisoned Guangdong and campaigned against the Yangchun tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Nanxiong Zhao Yong garrisoned Guangdong and campaigned against the Yangchun tribes.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、日本、安南、占城、真臘、爪哇入貢，日本以無表卻之。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Japan, Annam, Champa, Cambodia, and Java sent tribute; Japan's tribute was declined for lack of a formal memorial.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Ryukyu, Japan, Annam, Champa, Cambodia, and Java sent tribute; Japan's tribute was declined for lack of a formal memorial.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月戊子，徐達為征虜大將軍，湯和、傅友德為左、右副將軍，帥師討乃兒不花。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, spring, first month, on the day wuzi, Xu Da was made Grand General Who Conquers the Barbarians; Tang He and Fu Youde were left and right deputy generals; they led armies against Na'erbuhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on the wuzi day of the first spring month, Xu Da was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the Barbarians, with Tang He and Fu Youde as left and right deputy generals; they led armies against Na'erbuhua.

sentences.zh: 命新授官者各舉所知。

translations.literal: Newly appointed officials were each ordered to recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed officials were each ordered to recommend men they knew.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷天下歲造兵器。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the annual manufacture of weapons throughout the realm was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the annual manufacture of weapons throughout the realm was halted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命公候子弟入國學。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, sons of dukes and marquises were ordered to enter the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, sons of dukes and marquises were ordered to enter the National University.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔求隱逸。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict sought recluses.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict sought recluses.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，核天下官田。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengchen, official fields throughout the realm were audited.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengchen day, official fields throughout the realm were audited.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，大赦。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingxu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，頒《五經》、《四書》於北方學校。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Five Classics and Four Books were promulgated to schools in the north.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the Five Classics and Four Books were promulgated to schools in the north.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，徐達率諸將出塞，至北黃河，擊破元兵，獲全寧四部以歸。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day gengwu, Xu Da led the generals beyond the frontier to the Northern Yellow River, defeated Yuan forces, and returned with the four divisions of Quanning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengwu day, Xu Da led the generals beyond the frontier to the Northern Yellow River, defeated the Yuan army, and returned with the four divisions of Quanning.

sentences.zh: 五月，五溪蠻叛，江夏侯周德興討平之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Wuxi barbarians rebelled; Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Wuxi barbarians rebelled and Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing subdued them.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙子，詔求明經老成之士，有司禮送京師。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the day bingzi, an edict sought elderly scholars versed in the classics; officials were respectfully to escort them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the bingzi day, an edict sought elderly scholars versed in the classics, to be escorted to the capital with all due ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，河決原武、祥符、中牟。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Yellow River broke its banks at Yuanwu, Xiangfu, and Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the Yellow River broke its banks at Yuanwu, Xiangfu, and Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徐達還。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午朔，傅友德為征南將軍，藍玉、沐英為左、右副將軍，帥征支南。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, renwu, Fu Youde was southern expedition general, with Lan Yu and Mu Ying as left and right deputy generals, leading an army to conquer Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the first of the ninth month, Fu Youde was appointed southern expedition general with Lan Yu and Mu Ying as left and right deputies, leading an army to conquer Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 徐達鎮北平。

translations.literal: Xu Da garrisoned Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da garrisoned Beiping.

sentences.zh: 丙午，周德興移師討施州蠻，平之。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Zhou Dexing shifted his army to attack the Shizhou barbarians and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Zhou Dexing shifted his army to attack the Shizhou barbarians and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day renzi, the first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, the renzi day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命法司錄囚，會翰林院給事中及春坊官會議平允以聞。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the judiciary was ordered to record prisoners; academicians of the Hanlin Academy and officials of the Eastern Palace were to meet and discuss fairness and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the judiciary was ordered to review prisoners, and Hanlin academicians together with Eastern Palace officials were to meet, discuss fairness, and report.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免應天、太平、應德、鎮江、甯國田租。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, land tax in Yingtian, Taiping, Yingde, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, land tax in Yingtian, Taiping, Yingde, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo was remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，分遣御史錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, censors were separately dispatched to record prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, censors were separately dispatched to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己卯，延安侯唐勝宗帥師討浙東山寇，平之。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Marquis of Yan'an Tang Shengzong led an army to attack mountain bandits in eastern Zhe and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Marquis of Yan'an Tang Shengzong led an army against mountain bandits in eastern Zhe and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，吉安侯陸仲亨鎮成都。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renwu, Marquis of Ji'an Lu Zhongheng garrisoned Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renwu day, Marquis of Ji'an Lu Zhongheng garrisoned Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，趙庸討廣州海寇，大破之。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Zhao Yong attacked Guangzhou sea bandits and inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Zhao Yong attacked Guangzhou sea bandits and routed them.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，命翰林春坊官考駁諸司章奏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingsi, Hanlin and Eastern Palace officials were ordered to examine and assess memorials from all offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingsi day, Hanlin and Eastern Palace officials were ordered to examine memorials from all offices.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，傅友德大敗元兵於白石江，遂下曲靖。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Fu Youde inflicted a great defeat on Yuan forces at the White Stone River and then took Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Fu Youde routed Yuan forces at the White Stone River and then captured Qujing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，元梁王把匝剌瓦爾密走普寧自殺。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Yuan Prince of Liang Bazhila'ermi fled to Puning and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the Yuan Prince of Liang Bazhila'ermi fled to Puning and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、安南、爪哇、朵甘、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Annan, Java, Doker, and U-Tsang presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Siam, Annan, Java, Doker, and U-Tsang presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 以安南寇思明，不納。

translations.literal: Because Annan raided Siming, tribute was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Annan had raided Siming, their tribute was refused.
